body:
The standard library is a mess from when we still didn't have
       `inline while`, `$T`, methods, etc. should be rewritten completely 
- [ ] ABI static/full size utils
- [ ] ABI selector computation helpers
- [ ] Reusable memory ABI encoder
- [ ] ABI decoder that's generic over memory/calldata
- [ ] ABI utils that reusable for/with event data encoding
- [ ] update require / revert helpers to automatically accept structs as error types
requirements: ABI decoder that's generic over memory/calldata
